snippet.title: Project X Light Years - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
#ProjectXLightYears #Shmup #RetroGaming #Team17 #ShootEmUp #Amiga #arcadeshooter #mk_games_official

Project X: Light Years is the official return of the legendary 1992 Team17 shmup, reborn for a new generation! 
After 32 years, the iconic Amiga shoot ’em up blasts back with modern visuals, reimagined gameplay, epic boss battles, and all the space combat action you remember. 
Whether you're a retro gaming veteran or discovering the series for the first time, prepare for intense arcade shooter action.

🔥 Classic shoot ’em up gameplay with modern graphics
🚀 Epic side-scrolling space battles
🎮 Officially licensed Team17 title
⚡ Nostalgic Amiga vibes with updated mechanics
👾 Challenging boss fights and unique enemy patterns

👉 Wishlist now on https://store.steampowered.com/app/3080530/Project_X_Light_Years/
📢 Follow for updates: https://www.facebook.com/ProjectXLightYears
